scope: Prepare combined A-C data for provisional development experiments; do not run models yet.

B.basis: Prior explicit user assumption for Batch B
B.user_instruction: Proceed, assuming the labels have been reviewed
B.label_policy: Use the supplied draft_label_if_unanimous_include field for prepared development cases.

C.basis: Explicit user authorization for a provisional run
C.user_instruction: Record an explicit provisional-run assumption for batch C and combine all three datasets for A-C
C.label_policy: Use a binary label only when all three saved reviewers agree for a case in the prepared C development package; stop on disagreement or missing evidence.

family_policy: Union existing global and per-batch family links across all 506 candidate IDs; conservatively group identical source/FULL texts; reject development families crossing chronological periods or carrying calibration exposure outside training. Preserve unresolved companion warnings and provisional family status.
text_policy: Reuse exact upstream FULL/MASKED strings; preserve batch-specific preprocessing versions. No new masks or corrections from development errors.
test_policy: Candidate metadata only for 2023-2024; no test texts or labels in the combined development release.
